svg.text: Pretend H0 is true, see where sample z-scores usually land, and draw the line where results become surprising.
1. If H0 is true, where do samples land?
Even when H0 is true, 5% of samples land in the red tails.
Rejecting then is a Type I error. That 5% is α.
2. Splitting α moves the line out
Ha: μ > μ0 (right-tailed): all 5% on the right
Same sample: the one-tailed test rejects, the two-tailed test does not.
So choose the tail from the question, before seeing the data.
